notes: 「工作区显示」卡片两处改动：① 默认折叠智能体（subagent）子会话，一屏只剩你自己的会话，需要时勾「显示智能体」一并列出（本机 99 条会话里有 80 条是智能体的）；② 隐藏/显示不再只改状态文件，改走宿主的 workspaceRegistry，落盘的同时触发会话列表推送，在面板上切换立刻生效，不用重启客户端。宿主服务取不到时自动退回原来的文件写法并在提示里说明。
notesEn: Two changes to the "Workspace visibility" card: (1) agent (subagent) sessions are collapsed by default so you only see your own sessions — tick "Show agents" to list them (80 of 99 sessions on this machine were agent sessions); (2) hide/show no longer writes the state file only — it goes through the host workspaceRegistry, which persists and pushes the session-list update, so toggles take effect immediately without restarting the client. If the host service is unavailable it falls back to the previous file-based write and says so in the hint.
